definitions.EXPERIMENTAL: Research prototype: real mathematics, not hardened for production use.
definitions.HARDWARE_BACKED: Backed by dedicated hardware (e.g. an SGX/SEV enclave or a vendor MEC/5G control plane).
definitions.LOCAL: Real computation with local-only, single-process scope (not a distributed production integration).
definitions.REAL: Real functionality operating on real inputs - no simulated components.
definitions.SIMULATED: Modeled or emulated behavior - the underlying integration does not exist in this build.

adversarial.consumes: The live score stream (evasion watch window) and the fitted model with recent feature vectors (drift and robustness runs).
adversarial.detail: evasion watch warming up; model trained
adversarial.failure: Guarded (component 'adversarial_watch'); drift refresh is best effort and report endpoints return available:false instead of raising.
adversarial.note: White-box evasion, drift and robustness analysis against the fitted model.
adversarial.produces: Evasion/drift context as system events and audit entries, plus on-demand robustness reports; surfaced as robustness observations in investigations.
adversarial.title: Adversarial resilience

audit.consumes: Audit events emitted across the pipeline and flow records committed as Merkle leaves at capture stop.
audit.failure: Guarded (component 'audit'): appends are best effort - a failure is counted and logged while capture and detection continue.
audit.note: Research-grade pure-Python cryptography (hash chain, Merkle, Schnorr, ZK statements); not production-hardened. Proofs demonstrate tamper-evidence of this log, not regulatory compliance.
audit.produces: Tamper-evident integrity references - chained entries, Merkle inclusion proofs, signed checkpoints - which investigation bundles cite for incident/alert actions.
audit.title: Audit chain / ZKP

bio.consumes: Scored feature vectors plus drift/evasion context and the edge timing scale.
bio.failure: Guarded (component 'bio'): an untrained or failing bio system is skipped; detection continues without the annotation.
bio.produces: Behavioural annotations (immune danger level, SNN score, swarm vote) on flow records and alerts - supporting evidence that never invents an independent threat verdict.
bio.title: Bio-inspired detection

correlation.consumes: Published flow records (endpoints, SNI, sector) and hydrated flow history.
correlation.failure: Guarded (component 'correlation'): a graph failure never kills publication, and bundles degrade to available:false graph/twin sections.
correlation.note: Attack-graph correlation over observed flow records.
correlation.produces: Attack-graph nodes/edges plus incident relatedness context: anchors, affected entities and one-hop graph slices for investigations.
correlation.title: Correlation graph

edge.consumes: Flow records for slice classification, fitted micro-detector features for local scoring, and link profile RTT for the timing scale.
edge.failure: Guarded (component 'edge_slice'): classification falls back to the 'default' slice and capture continues.
edge.note: Real micro-detector scoring with local, single-process scope.
edge.produces: Network-slice tags on flows and alerts, slice policy adjustments for the immune ladder, and local micro-detector latency reports.
edge.title: Edge / 5G slicing

edge_deployment.consumes: Deploy requests naming a node and a network slice.
edge_deployment.detail: 0 simulated deployment(s) registered (no MEC/5G control plane)
edge_deployment.failure: Off the detection path: validation errors return HTTP 400 on its own routes only.
edge_deployment.note: In-process deployment/NTN registry; no real MEC or 5G control plane.
edge_deployment.produces: In-process deployment records explicitly marked capability: SIMULATED - not a remote edge agent.
edge_deployment.title: Edge deployment registry

federated.consumes: Model delta vectors (explicit, or derived from the live score window).
federated.detail: simulated parties; secret sharing verified locally
federated.failure: Off the detection path: errors surface as explicit API errors only.
federated.note: Real secret-sharing math (additive k-of-k, or opt-in Shamir t-of-n with dropout) over locally simulated parties.
federated.produces: Secret-shared secure aggregation over locally simulated parties with a verifiable aggregate digest.
federated.title: Federated aggregation

intel.consumes: ja3/ja4/sni fields already parsed from TLS/QUIC handshakes (never payload) plus the list files under the intel directory.
intel.detail: no list files - intel is off
intel.failure: Guarded (component 'intel'): a bad directory or list degrades to empty lists with a counted failure; capture and scoring continue without intel.
intel.note: Operator-maintained file lists matched against parsed handshake metadata; a hit is evidence, never an auto-verdict.
intel.produces: intel_* classification signals (spectra.threats), record['intel'] hits on flows, and list provenance on GET /api/model/intel.
intel.title: Local threat intel (JA3/JA4/SNI lists)

pqc.consumes: Parsed TLS/QUIC handshake metadata (versions, groups, ciphers, JA3/JA4) from every scored flow.
pqc.failure: Guarded on the detection path (component 'pqc'): a failure drops the annotation, never the flow.
pqc.note: Heuristic quantum-risk scoring over real parsed TLS/QUIC handshakes.
pqc.produces: Per-flow quantum-risk assessment persisted on the flow record and copied onto alerts as module evidence; an endpoint inventory with a migration roadmap.
pqc.title: PQC crypto-readiness

tee.consumes: The model artifact path (for its measurement), caller-supplied nonces, feature vectors and quotes.
tee.failure: Off the detection path: a missing enclave raises TeeError -> HTTP 400 on its own routes and never affects scoring or capture.
tee.note: Simulated enclave in-process; a real deployment requires SGX/SEV hardware. Never hardware-backed in this build.
tee.produces: Local simulated attestation quotes, verification checks and sealed-inference receipts - reported as simulated unless real hardware is present, which it never is in this build.
tee.title: TEE attestation

twin.consumes: The correlation graph topology built from observed flows only (no invented infrastructure).
twin.failure: Read-side only: bundle twin context degrades to available:false and never raises into the pipeline.
twin.note: Deterministic local simulator; no live-network coupling.
twin.produces: Deterministic blast-radius simulation, playbook rehearsal and zone/criticality context alongside an investigation.
twin.title: Digital twin

body.scoring_policy: No advanced module changes the anomaly score, the alert confidence, or the severity: every module contributes supporting evidence or context only, and no module may invent an independent threat verdict.
